ExternalTechnicalVerdict.description:
One decision.v1 horizon object, as produced by an external technical engine.

Field names follow decision.v1 (camelCase); the snake_case aliases are
accepted too, so the same payload can be posted from either side.

HorizonTechnicalVerdict.description:
One horizon's independent verdict, exactly as Vincent's engine produced it.

His engine emits short/mid/long verdicts independently, with no overall
action. This carries each one through untouched so nothing here averages
them together.
HorizonTechnicalVerdict.title: HorizonTechnicalVerdict

SupportingContext.description:
Ryan's non-technical layers, reported beside an external technical action.

Vincent's engine forbids fundamental, valuation, options and news data from
entering a recommendation. So when his verdict is present these layers are
computed and shown, but they never move his action. `agrees_with_action`
is the honest summary: does the rest of the evidence point the same way?
SupportingContext.title: SupportingContext
